13.heading: Pasdammim:
refs: Ephes-dammim is here called Pas-dammim, by apheresis. 1Sa 17:1 , Ephes-dammim
In Samuel it is, "a piece of ground full of lentiles
" and there is probably a mistake of seorim, "barley," for adashim, "lentiles," or vice-versa. Some, however, think there were both lentiles and barley in the field, which is not unlikely.
